evals.prompt: Validate the criteria and scenarios of this backlog before I baseline it.
evals.expected_output: All stories Ready, coverage matrix complete, no invented findings.
expectations: Verdict is Ready for the stories without blockers or majors
Coverage matrix shows each criterion with its scenarios
Does not pad the report with invented Minor findings
Does not rewrite or edit the stories

evals.prompt: I think the criteria of these stories are weak. Check them.
evals.expected_output: Findings per criterion with quoted text, severity and suggested fix; stories with defects not marked Ready.
expectations: Flags the story with fewer than two criteria
Flags the criterion with no When and the story with no 'so that'
Flags vague wording ('works', 'fast') as unmeasurable, quoting the exact text
Each finding names its location (story, AC number)
Suggested fixes needing a number or message are marked as needing the author's value
Does not rewrite the criteria in the source

evals.prompt: Do the test scenarios of these stories actually cover the criteria?
evals.expected_output: Uncovered criteria, a story with no scenarios, invalid type, nonexistent criterion link and happy-path-only stories reported.
expectations: Reports the story with no scenarios as Not testable or Major
Reports the scenario linked to a criterion that does not exist
Reports criteria that no scenario covers in the coverage matrix
Flags stories with only happy-path scenarios and names the missing angle (negative, boundary, permission)
Flags the Scenario Outline placeholder with no Examples column
Proposes the missing scenarios in the report, in Gherkin, tagged @proposed and linked to existing criteria, without editing the backlog

evals.prompt: Complete the missing criteria and scenarios for these stories.
evals.expected_output: Report with proposed criteria and scenarios, plus a merged copy; the original untouched; no invented values.
expectations: Runs the check first and lists the gaps
Writes <name>-qa-checked.md as a copy and leaves the original file unchanged
Proposed scenarios use new unique TC ids and tags @TC-xx @type @ACn @proposed
Proposed criteria continue the AC numbering and are marked (proposed)
Values missing from the story become 'needs the author's value' and open questions, not invented
Re-runs the form check on the merged copy

evals.prompt: Check the criteria and tests of ST-02 and ST-03 in this backlog.
evals.expected_output: Only the two stories are checked, with their findings and coverage; the rest of the backlog is not judged and the source file is untouched.
expectations: Checks only ST-02 and ST-03 and says the other stories were not checked
Uses the story, AC and TC IDs of the backlog in every finding
Saves the report as a separate file and does not modify the backlog

evals.prompt: Valida os critérios de aceite desta história: '#### ST-01 — Publicar livro. As a student, I want to publish a book, so that others find it. Critério: o formulário funciona bem.'
evals.expected_output: Report in Portuguese; the vague criterion flagged as Blocker; no invented criteria.
expectations: Report is in Portuguese
Flags 'funciona bem' as untestable (Blocker) quoting it
Flags that the story has fewer than two criteria and no scenarios
Does not invent criteria or numbers; lists what the author must define
Keeps Given / When / Then keywords in English if it proposes a fix

evals.prompt: Check whether the criteria match what the descriptions say.
evals.expected_output: Description rules with no criterion found and quoted; proposed criteria in Given / When / Then with no invented value.
expectations: Flags that ST-01's description states a 120-character maximum for the title and no criterion covers it, quoting the description
Flags that ST-02's description states only the owner can remove a listing and no criterion covers it
Flags ST-02 AC2 ('it works correctly') as untestable
Proposes criteria for the gaps in Given / When / Then, marked proposed and citing the description sentence
Does not invent a message for the over-limit case; marks it as needing the author's value and adds an open question
Proposes a boundary scenario for 120/121 characters and a permission scenario for another student, tagged @proposed
Does not modify the backlog file

evals.prompt: Check this story: '#### ST-09 — Export report. As a manager, I want to export a report, so that I can share it.' (no description, no criteria)
evals.expected_output: Not testable, no proposals invented, pointed back to backlog-creator.
expectations: Verdict is Not testable
Proposes no criteria and no scenarios because the story states no behaviour
Lists what the author must define as open questions
Points to backlog-creator
